metadata.notes: Core historical date/location checks only; source dependence and quantitative restrictions explicit.

reviews.title_after: The Lindsay Snowstorm paralyzes New York City
reviews.secondary_publisher: NYC Emergency Management / NOAA original Storm Data
reviews.core_fact: A February 9–10, 1969 snowstorm struck New York City and became known as the Lindsay Snowstorm.
reviews.source_dependence: Municipal historic storm chronology and contemporary federal storm-data archive, distinct source provenance.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Citywide 20-inch municipal hazard-history number is not the same as the Central Park station's ~15.3-inch storm total; exact clock and daily totals require review.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original borough snow observation map and disruption timeline

reviews.title_before: Tornado — CLOVIS HILLCREST ARP, New Mexico
reviews.title_after: A destructive tornado tracks through Clovis, New Mexico
reviews.location_after: Clovis and Curry County, New Mexico
reviews.core_fact: A damaging tornado crossed southern and eastern Clovis on March 23, 2007 after entering Curry County from Roosevelt County.
reviews.source_dependence: NOAA Storm Data and NWS Albuquerque historical summary reuse underlying storm survey.
reviews.unverified_cautions: The Clovis Airpark NCEI record represents part of one tornado path; confirm historical F2 versus EF2 nomenclature, because February 2007 was the EF transition.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Clovis tornado track map with county and damage segments

reviews.title_before: Winter Storm — EASTERN CLINTON, New York
reviews.title_after: A powerful April nor'easter brings snow and flooding to the Northeast
reviews.location_after: Northern New York, Vermont and the northeastern United States
reviews.core_fact: A significant April 15–16, 2007 nor'easter brought heavy wet inland snow and widespread rain and flooding in other parts of the Northeast.
reviews.source_dependence: NWS Albany/Philadelphia regional histories corroborate the wider NOAA/NCEI local weather record.
reviews.unverified_cautions: The Clinton County winter storm is a local segment; snow, heavy rain, winds and flood peaks occurred at different sites and hours over April 15–16.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original cyclone track and elevation-dependent rain/snow analysis

reviews.title_after: Mounds Landing levee breach inundates the Mississippi Delta
reviews.secondary_publisher: Mississippi Department of Archives and History
reviews.core_fact: On April 21, 1927, the Mississippi River levee broke at Mound Landing, initiating catastrophic Mississippi Delta flooding.
reviews.source_dependence: NOAA/NWS Mississippi history and an independent state historical archive date the levee break.
reviews.unverified_cautions: April21 is the breach date, not the start or culmination of months-long flooding; LOC photos can show April25 aftermath, not the exact breach moment, and rights are unreviewed.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original 1927 Delta flood map with breach location and spread chronology

reviews.title_after: An EF4 tornado devastates neighborhoods near Granbury, Texas
reviews.core_fact: An EF4 tornado crossed Lake Granbury and struck communities in Hood County on May 15, 2013.
reviews.source_dependence: NOAA/NCEI and NWS Fort Worth share initial survey data, not separate peak-wind instruments.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Mambrino is a segment/locality in the Granbury event, not a separate EF4; other individual surveyed tornadoes occurred nearby; EF4 damage intensity was localized.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original surveyed EF intensity route around Lake Granbury

reviews.title_after: A weather forecast delays the D-Day invasion by 24 hours
reviews.core_fact: Unfavorable weather forecasts led Eisenhower to postpone on June 4, 1944 the Normandy landings originally planned for June 5; the invasion followed June 6.
reviews.source_dependence: ECMWF meteorological reconstruction and RMet historical synthesis use shared military forecast records interpreted separately.
reviews.unverified_cautions: June4 is the forecast/command decision, NOT the landings; the decision to go June6 was separate, and historic chart rights require permission.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original surface-pressure forecast evolution and command decision timeline

reviews.title_after: The Flint–Beecher F5 tornado devastates Michigan
reviews.core_fact: An F5 tornado struck the Beecher district north of Flint on June 8, 1953, becoming Michigan's deadliest documented tornado.
reviews.source_dependence: Two NOAA retrospective pages use underlying Weather Bureau and surveyed historical damage, not independent wind measurement.
reviews.unverified_cautions: F5 is the historical Fujita category, NOT EF5; 116 fatalities apply to this tornado versus 126 wider Michigan tornado deaths that day; warning conventions differed in 1953.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original 1953 tornado path and Weather Bureau bulletin timeline

reviews.title_after: A violent tornado cuts through South Moravia, Czechia
reviews.core_fact: A damaging violent tornado crossed southern Moravia on June 24, 2021; a multinational survey documented a maximum IF4 classification.
reviews.source_dependence: ESSL and Czech institutions document the same joint damage survey; not independent intensity measurements.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Survey says IF4 on International Fujita, NOT EF4, with localized maximum along a 27.1-km path; chronology is UTC with Czech local time conversion.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original South Moravia path and International Fujita damage-intensity gradient

reviews.title_after: Overnight flash flooding devastates Johnstown, Pennsylvania
reviews.location_after: Johnstown and Conemaugh River basin, Pennsylvania
reviews.core_fact: Thunderstorms on the night of July 19–20, 1977 triggered devastating flooding in and near Johnstown, Pennsylvania.
reviews.source_dependence: USGS hydrologic field study and community museum history independently describe the 1977 event.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Rain began late July19, impacts continued July20, and individual tributary peak stages differ by site, clock and streamgage; dam failures were not the entire flood cause.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original tributary streamgage hydrographs and rainstorm map

reviews.title_after: Hurricane Celia strikes Corpus Christi with destructive winds
reviews.location_after: Corpus Christi and the central Texas coast
reviews.core_fact: Hurricane Celia reached the central Texas coast near Corpus Christi on August 3, 1970, bringing extreme winds and significant damage.
reviews.source_dependence: NOAA Corpus Christi historical case study and WPC rainfall study share storm history but cover distinct observation products.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Agency intensity estimates, direct station gust observations and 1-minute sustained wind speeds must not be interchanged; rainfall may peak on other dates.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original coastal track and named station wind timeline

reviews.title_after: Category 5 Hurricane Dorian strikes the Abaco Islands
reviews.location_after: Elbow Cay and Great Abaco, The Bahamas
reviews.core_fact: Hurricane Dorian became Category 5 and made landfall in the northern Bahamas on September 1, 2019, then stalled over the region.
reviews.source_dependence: NHC operational atmospheric analysis and regional emergency-management history independently record impact but often share cyclone intensity sourcing.
reviews.unverified_cautions: NHC 8 AM advisory describes impending, not completed 12:40 PM landfall; initial and second landfalls, storm stalling and response mortality reports have separate dates.

reviews.title_after: A violent F4 tornado returns to Xenia, Ohio
reviews.core_fact: On September 20, 2000, a tornado struck Xenia, Ohio, reaching F4 intensity, separate from the city's 1974 tornado.
reviews.source_dependence: NWS original survey supplemented by CIMSS remote-sensing chronology; F-rating derives from survey.
reviews.unverified_cautions: The 2000 rating was historical F4, NOT EF4; do not call this the April 1974 storm. CIMSS UTC storm timestamp must be converted to EDT.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original side-by-side 1974 and 2000 tornado track comparison

reviews.title_after: Super Typhoon Yutu nears Saipan and Tinian as catastrophic winds loom
reviews.core_fact: On October 24, 2018, Super Typhoon Yutu approached Saipan and Tinian, with catastrophic winds expected; center crossed early October 25 local time.
reviews.source_dependence: NCEI event range and NASA storm imagery/agency summary describe separate timing products, but are not independent station wind data.
reviews.unverified_cautions: October24 warnings and UTC imagery must not become October24 island-local landfall; NCEI Guam and Northern Marianas zone records differ.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original UTC vs Chamorro Standard Time landfall/warning timeline

reviews.title_after: Super Typhoon Goni makes landfall on Catanduanes, Philippines
reviews.core_fact: Super Typhoon Goni, called Rolly locally, struck Catanduanes, Philippines on November 1, 2020.
reviews.source_dependence: Asian Disaster Reduction Center and NASA independent publishers corroborate event/date; intensity reports ultimately depend on meteorological agencies.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Published 03:50 vs 04:50 local first landfall times conflict; do not use exact time pending PAGASA final audit. NASA satellite imagery dated Oct31 shows approach, not Nov1 landfall.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Catanduanes track and UTC-to-local satellite imagery timeline

reviews.title_after: South Dakota winter storm develops into a prolonged blizzard
reviews.location_after: Todd County and central South Dakota
reviews.core_fact: Winter precipitation, icing and snow affected South Dakota during December 13, 2022, in a larger storm lasting December 12–16.
reviews.source_dependence: NCEI source plus NOAA regional timeline share agency observations but distinguish phases.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Do not present Dec13 as the peak of statewide blizzard winds that intensified in later days, particularly Dec15; county zone report can span days.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Dec12–16 snow/ice/wind sequence highlighting Dec13 conditions
